component.name: ChatterSyn
component.summary: Twitch and YouTube live chat in one window

description.p: ChatterSyn is a Chatterino-style chat client that shows Twitch and YouTube live chat in one merged feed, and posts to both chats from a single input.

ul.li: One tab per stream: a Twitch channel and a YouTube live chat side by side
A Stream tab that follows your own channel and connects when you go live
One message box that sends to Twitch, YouTube or both
Twitch, 7TV, BTTV and FFZ emotes, animated, with an emote picker
Twitch badges, replies and user cards with recent messages
Moderation from the user card on both platforms, where you have mod rights
Highlights, mentions, search, chat logs, hotkeys and dark or light themes

description.p: Reading Twitch chat needs no account. Sending messages, YouTube chat and moderation need you to sign in with Twitch or Google.
